recognize_zh: 內視鏡可見胃竇無蒂息肉；低倍 H&E 顯示黏膜下緊密排列、背靠背的結節狀淋巴濾泡，高倍以小型淋巴球為主；CD20 與 CD10 陽性的腫瘤濾泡同時表現 BCL-2，符合低惡度濾泡性淋巴瘤而非反應性濾泡。
features: Endoscopic sessile polypoid lesion in the gastric antrum
Low power: closely packed, back-to-back nodular follicles expanding the mucosa/submucosa with attenuated mantle zones
High power: monotonous small lymphoid cells beneath gastric glands without obvious tingible-body macrophages
CD20 and CD10 strongly positive throughout the neoplastic follicles
BCL-2 strongly positive within the follicles (inappropriate germinal center BCL-2 expression)
describe_en: Endoscopy shows a sessile polyp in the gastric antrum. The resected polyp contains a nodular lymphoid proliferation of closely packed, back-to-back follicles with attenuated mantle zones, composed predominantly of small lymphoid cells beneath the gastric mucosa. The follicles are strongly positive for CD20 and CD10 and show diffuse BCL-2 coexpression. Findings are consistent with low-grade follicular lymphoma, follicular pattern, involving the stomach.

ddx.vs: MALT lymphoma shows marginal zone/monocytoid cells with lymphoepithelial lesions and follicular colonization, and is CD10- and BCL6-negative.
Reactive germinal centers are polarized with tingible-body macrophages and are BCL-2 negative.
MCL shows nodules of CD5+/cyclin D1+ cells that are CD10-negative.
Duodenal-type FL involves small bowel mucosa as small polyps; gastric involvement by a mass lesion favors systemic/conventional FL requiring staging.

stain: Endoscopic photo; H&E; IHC: CD20, CD10, BCL-2
